description: This file defines the interface and class declaration for the WifiManager plugin, which manages WiFi-related operations such as scanning, connecting, WPS pairing, signal threshold handling, and event notifications within the WPEFramework environment. It includes method signatures, external dependencies, and event callbacks but lacks implementations.

classes.name: WifiManager
classes.description: A plugin class managing WiFi operations, inheriting JSONRPC and plugin interface functionalities within the WPEFramework environment. Responsible for handling WiFi state changes, scans, connections, WPS, signals, and event notifications.
